commitments.detail: The exclusive worldwide commercial license will expressly reserve the university consortium's continuing non-commercial research rights with the diagnostic platform, as required by the prior agreement identified in the chain-of-title review.
Sublicense permission will be limited specifically to accredited hospitals, consistent with Helixion's confirmed deployment model, rather than the broad sublicensing currently permitted in the draft.
The license will prohibit transfers of controlled technical documentation (ECCN 3E001) to embargoed jurisdictions and require an end-user certificate before any such transfer.
